outcome: Autism-like behaviors at 18 months, 3 years, and 5 years
cohort: 1520 women and their children from the Ma'anshan birth cohort (MABC) in China, recruited between May 2013 and September 2014
finding: Exclusive breastfeeding at 4 months of age mediated the association between caesarean delivery and children's autism-like behaviours at 18 months and 3 years, but not at 5 years.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with a lower proportion of exclusive breastfeeding at 4 months and subsequently with an increased likelihood of autism-like behaviors in children at 18 months and 3 years.
